title: Beyond the Evidence Coherence Trap: Agent-Driven Evidence Selection for Temporally Disordered Fake News Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.36764v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fake news undermines public trust and the integrity of online information ecosystems. Temporally disordered fake news is especially elusive because it rearranges factual events into a false chronology. Individual events may remain factually valid even when their temporal relations are misrepresented. When similar events involving the same entity recur, retrieval may return semantically plausible evidence from the wrong period. Consequently, independent event verification may rely on locally coherent but temporally mismatched evidence and incorrectly validate the article. We call this the \textit{evidence coherence trap}. Because existing benchmarks rarely isolate this setting, we construct ChronoFake, a source-disjoint benchmark of 30,706 articles derived from temporally anchored real events. translated_title: 超越证据一致性陷阱：面向时序错乱假新闻检测的智能体驱动证据选择
translated_abstract: 假新闻破坏了公众信任和在线信息生态系统的完整性。时序错乱的假新闻尤其难以识别，因为它将真实事件重新排列成虚假的时间顺序。即使事件之间的时间关系被歪曲，单个事件在事实上可能仍然有效。当涉及同一实体的类似事件重复发生时，检索可能会返回来自错误时期的、语义上看似合理的证据。因此，独立的事件验证可能依赖于局部一致但时间上不匹配的证据，从而错误地判定文章为真。我们将这种现象称为“证据一致性陷阱”。由于现有基准很少孤立地针对这一场景，我们构建了ChronoFake，这是一个包含30,706篇文章的源不相交基准，其文章源自具有时间锚定的真实事件。该基准能够区分时间操纵与有效叙述（包括倒叙）。为解决这一问题，我们提出了DelSA，一个文档……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文针对时序错乱假新闻提出了“证据一致性陷阱”问题，构建了ChronoFake基准并设计了智能体驱动的证据选择方法DelSA，通过选择时间匹配的证据来避免被局部一致但时序错误的证据误导。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the "evidence coherence trap" in detecting temporally disordered fake news, constructs the ChronoFake benchmark, and proposes DelSA, an agent-driven evidence selection method that avoids being misled by locally coherent but temporally mismatched evidence.
